```
3	import { fetchRollbarErrors } from './rollbar-client';
4	import { Digest } from './types';
5	
6	async function run(): Promise<void> {
7		const rollbarToken = process.env['ROLLBAR_READ_TOKEN'];
8	
9		if (!rollbarToken) {
10			throw new Error('ROLLBAR_READ_TOKEN is required');
11		}
12	
13		console.log('Fetching Rollbar errors (last 24h)...');
14		const errors = await fetchRollbarErrors({ readToken: rollbarToken });
15		console.log(`Fetched ${errors.length} active error items from Rollbar`);
16	
17		const newItemsCount = errors.filter((e) => e.isNew).length;
18	
19		const digest: Digest = {
20			generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
21			rollbar: {
22				totalItemsActive24h: errors.length,
23				newItemsCount,
24			},
25			errors,
26		};
27	
28		writeFileSync('rollbar-digest.json', JSON.stringify(digest, null, 2));
29		console.log('Digest written to rollbar-digest.json');
30		console.log(`Total active items: ${errors.length}, new in 24h: ${newItemsCount}`);
31	}
32	
33	run().catch((err: unknown) => {
34		console.error('Monitor script failed:', err);
35		process.exit(1);
36	});
```

```
1	import { NewRelicError } from './types';
2	
3	const NR_GRAPHQL_URL = 'https://api.newrelic.com/graphql';
4	
5	interface NerdGraphResponse {
6		data: {
7			actor: {
8				account: {
9					current: { results: Array<Record<string, unknown>> };
10					previous: { results: Array<Record<string, unknown>> };
11				};
12			};
13		};
14	}
15	
16	export async function fetchNewRelicErrors({
17		apiKey,
18		accountId,
19	}: {
20		apiKey: string;
21		accountId: string;
22	}): Promise<NewRelicError[]> {
23		const baseNrql =
24			"SELECT count(*) as errorCount, latest(error.class) as errorClass, latest(request.uri) as requestUri FROM TransactionError WHERE appName LIKE '%Recommendations Service (production)%' FACET error.class, error.message, transactionName LIMIT 30";
25	
26		const currentNrql = JSON.stringify(`${baseNrql} SINCE 24 HOURS AGO`);
27		const previousNrql = JSON.stringify(
28			`${baseNrql} SINCE 48 HOURS AGO UNTIL 24 HOURS AGO`,
29		);
30	
31		const query = `{
32	    actor {
33	      account(id: ${accountId}) {
34	        current: nrql(query: ${currentNrql}) { results }
35	        previous: nrql(query: ${previousNrql}) { results }
36	      }
37	    }
38	  }`;
39	
40		const response = await fetch(NR_GRAPHQL_URL, {
41			method: 'POST',
42			headers: {
43				'Content-Type': 'application/json',
44				'API-Key': apiKey,
45			},
46			body: JSON.stringify({ query }),
47		});
48	
49		if (!response.ok) {
50			throw new Error(`New Relic API error: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`);
51		}
52	
53		const json = (await response.json()) as NerdGraphResponse;
54		const currentResults = json.data.actor.account.current.results;
55		const previousResults = json.data.actor.account.previous.results;
56	
57		const previousMap = new Map<string, number>();
58		for (const row of previousResults) {
59			const key = `${String(row['error.class'] ?? '')}::${String(row['error.message'] ?? '')}::${String(row['transactionName'] ?? '')}`;
60			previousMap.set(key, Number(row['errorCount'] ?? 0));
61		}
62	
63		return currentResults.map((row) => {
64			const errorClass = String(row['error.class'] ?? 'Unknown');
65			const errorMessage = String(row['error.message'] ?? '');
66			const transactionName = String(row['transactionName'] ?? '');
67			const requestUri = String(row['requestUri'] ?? '');
68			const count = Number(row['errorCount'] ?? 0);
69	
70			const key = `${errorClass}::${errorMessage}::${transactionName}`;
71			const countPrevious24h = previousMap.get(key) ?? 0;
72			const changePercent =
73				countPrevious24h === 0
74					? null
75					: Math.round(((count - countPrevious24h) / countPrevious24h) * 100);
76	
77			return {
78				errorClass,
79				errorMessage,
80				transactionName,
81				requestUri,
82				count,
83				countPrevious24h,
84				changePercent,
85			};
86		});
87	}
88
```

```
1	import { RollbarError } from './types';
2	
3	const ROLLBAR_API_URL = 'https://api.rollbar.com/api/1';
4	
5	interface RollbarItemListItem {
6		id: number;
7		fingerprint: string;
8		title: string;
9		level: string;
10		status: string;
11		total_occurrences: number;
12		first_occurrence_timestamp: number;
13		last_occurrence_timestamp: number;
14	}
15	
16	interface RollbarItemListResponse {
17		result: {
18			items: RollbarItemListItem[];
19			page: number;
20			total_count: number;
21		};
22	}
23	
24	interface RollbarFrame {
25		filename: string;
26		lineno: number;
27		method: string;
28	}
29	
30	interface RollbarOccurrence {
31		data: {
32			custom?: { correlationId?: string };
33			body?: {
34				trace_chain?: Array<{ frames?: RollbarFrame[] }>;
35				trace?: { frames?: RollbarFrame[] };
36			};
37		};
38	}
39	
40	interface RollbarInstancesResponse {
41		result: { instances: RollbarOccurrence[] };
42	}
43	
44	function parseTitle({ title }: { title: string }): [string, string] {
45		const colonIdx = title.indexOf(': ');
46		if (colonIdx === -1) return [title, ''];
47		return [title.slice(0, colonIdx), title.slice(colonIdx + 2)];
48	}
49	
50	async function fetchOccurrenceDetails({
51		headers,
52		itemId,
53	}: {
54		headers: Record<string, string>;
55		itemId: number;
56	}): Promise<{ stackTrace: string | null; correlationId: string | null }> {
57		const url = `${ROLLBAR_API_URL}/item/${itemId}/instances/?per_page=1`;
58		const resp = await fetch(url, { headers });
59		if (!resp.ok) return { stackTrace: null, correlationId: null };
60	
61		const json = (await resp.json()) as RollbarInstancesResponse;
62		const occurrence = json.result.instances[0];
63	
64		const correlationId = occurrence?.data?.custom?.correlationId ?? null;
65		const frames =
66			occurrence?.data?.body?.trace_chain?.[0]?.frames ??
67			occurrence?.data?.body?.trace?.frames ??
68			[];
69	
70		const stackTrace =
71			frames.length === 0
72				? null
73				: frames
74						.slice(0, 10)
75						.map((f) => `  at ${f.method} (${f.filename}:${f.lineno})`)
76						.join('\n');
77	
78		return { stackTrace, correlationId };
79	}
80	
81	export async function fetchRollbarErrors({
82		readToken,
83	}: {
84		readToken: string;
85	}): Promise<RollbarError[]> {
86		const rollbarHeaders = { 'X-Rollbar-Access-Token': readToken };
87		const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
88		const since24h = now - 86400;
89	
90		const allItems: RollbarItemListItem[] = [];
91		let page = 1;
92	
93		while (page <= 5) {
94			const url = `${ROLLBAR_API_URL}/items/?status=active&per_page=100&page=${page}&order=desc`;
95			const resp = await fetch(url, { headers: rollbarHeaders });
96			if (!resp.ok) break;
97	
98			const json = (await resp.json()) as RollbarItemListResponse;
99			const items = json.result.items;
100			if (items.length === 0) break;
101	
102			const recentItems = items.filter((i) => i.last_occurrence_timestamp >= since24h);
103			allItems.push(...recentItems);
104	
105			const lastItem = items[items.length - 1];
106			if (!lastItem || lastItem.last_occurrence_timestamp < since24h) break;
107	
108			page++;
109		}
110	
111		const topItems = allItems
112			.sort((a, b) => b.total_occurrences - a.total_occurrences)
113			.slice(0, 50);
114	
115		const errors = await Promise.all(
116			topItems.map(async (item, idx) => {
117				const [errorClass, errorMessage] = parseTitle({ title: item.title });
118	
119				let stackTrace: string | null = null;
120				let correlationId: string | null = null;
121	
122				if (idx < 10) {
123					const details = await fetchOccurrenceDetails({
124						headers: rollbarHeaders,
125						itemId: item.id,
126					});
127					stackTrace = details.stackTrace;
128					correlationId = details.correlationId;
129				}
130	
131				return {
132					itemId: item.id,
133					errorClass,
134					errorMessage,
135					level: item.level,
136					totalOccurrences: item.total_occurrences,
137					firstOccurrenceTimestamp: item.first_occurrence_timestamp,
138					lastOccurrenceTimestamp: item.last_occurrence_timestamp,
139					fingerprint: item.fingerprint,
140					isNew: item.first_occurrence_timestamp >= since24h,
141					stackTrace,
142					correlationId,
143					rollbarUrl: `https://rollbar.com/item/${item.id}/`,
144				};
145			}),
146		);
147	
148		return errors;
149	}
150
```

```
8	@Injectable({ scope: Scope.REQUEST })
9	export class NewrelicService {
10		private group = 'default';
11		public readonly instance: typeof newrelic = newrelic;
12	
13		constructor(private readonly envConfig: EnvConfigService) {}
14	
15		setGroup({ group }: { group: string }): void {
16			this.group = group;
17		}
18	
19		recordMetric({
20			module,
21			metricName,
22			value,
23		}: {
24			module: string;
25			metricName: string;
26			value: number;
27		}): void {
28			this.instance.recordMetric(`${module}/${this.group}/${metricName}`, value);
29		}
30	
31		incrementMetric({ module, metricName }: { module: string; metricName: string }): void {
32			this.instance.incrementMetric(`${module}/${this.group}/${metricName}`, 1);
33		}
34	
35		attachMetadata(): void {
36			this.instance.addCustomAttribute(
37				'environment',
38				this.envConfig.get<string>({ key: NODE_ENV }),
39			);
40			this.instance.addCustomAttribute(
41				'serverName',
42				this.envConfig.get<string>({ key: SERVER_NAME }),
43			);
44		}
45	
46		getLinkingMetadata(): newrelic.LinkingMetadata {
47			return this.instance.getLinkingMetadata();
48		}
49	}
```

```json
  "content": "# New Relic Daily Monitor\n\nAutomated daily pipeline that queries New Relic NerdGraph for production metrics, detects anomalies, compares current performance against the 30-day baseline, and posts a Slack health report.\n\n## How It Works\n\n1. **GitHub Actions cron** triggers daily at 9:30am UTC (also triggerable manually via `workflow_dispatch`)\n2. **Fetch digest** (`src/scripts/newrelic-monitor/index.ts`): queries New Relic NerdGraph in a single batched request for errors, throughput, response time, error rate, Apdex, CPU, memory, and slow queries — both hourly timeseries (last 24h) and 30-day aggregates\n3. **Claude analysis**: reads `newrelic-digest.json`, evaluates thresholds, builds comparison table, posts Slack report\n\n## Metrics Collected\n\n### Performance Metrics (hourly timeseries + 30-day average)\n\n| Metric | Source Event | NRQL Aggregation |\n|--------|-------------|------------------|\n| **Throughput** | `Transaction` | `rate(count(*), 1 minute)` |\n| **Response Time (avg)** | `Transaction` | `average(duration) * 1000` |\n| **Error Rate** | `Transaction` | `percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true)` |\n| **Apdex** | `Transaction` | `apdex(duration, t: 0.5)` |\n| **CPU** | `SystemSample` | `average(cpuPercent)` |\n| **Memory** | `SystemSample` | `average(memoryUsedPercent)` |\n\nCPU and memory require the New Relic infrastructure agent. If not available, they are omitted from the report (`null` in digest).\n\n### Additional Queries\n\n| Data | Source | Description |\n|------|--------|-------------|\n| **Response Time (P95)** | `Transaction` | 24h aggregate and 30d aggregate |\n| **Error groups** | `TransactionError` | Top 30 by count, compared with prior 24h |\n| **Slow queries** | `Transaction` | Transactions with `databaseDuration > 1s`, top 10 |\n\n## Alert Thresholds\n\n| Metric | WARNING | CRITICAL |\n|--------|---------|----------|\n| Error Rate | ≥ 1% | ≥ 5% |\n| Response Time (avg) | ≥ 1000ms | ≥ 2000ms |\n| Apdex | ≤ 0.85 | ≤ 0.70 |\n| CPU | ≥ 70% | ≥ 85% |\n| Throughput drop vs 30d avg | — | ≥ 50% drop |\n\nNew error classes with > 10 occurrences also generate `NEW_ERROR` WARNING alerts.\n\n## Performance vs Baseline Comparison\n\nEvery report includes a comparison table of last-24h averages vs the 30-day rolling average:\n\n```\nMetric                  24h        30d Avg    Change\n──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nThroughput              42.3/m     38.1/m     +11% ↑\nResponse Time (avg)     245ms      230ms       +7% ↑\nResponse Time (P95)     890ms      750ms      +19% ↑ ⚠️\nError Rate              0.50%      0.30%      +67% ↑ 🔴\nApdex                   0.920      0.950       -3% ↓\nCPU                     34%        —          —\nMemory                  61%        —          —\n```\n\nThis gives visibility into whether recent releases have improved or degraded service health relative to historical baselines.\n\n## Digest Format (`newrelic-digest.json`)\n\n```typescript\n{\n  generatedAt: string;           // ISO timestamp\n  period: { from: string; to: string };\n  errors: {\n    total24h: number;            // total error occurrences in last 24h\n    newErrors: number;           // error classes not seen in prior 24h\n    groups: ErrorGroup[];        // top 30 by count\n  };\n  metrics: {\n    throughput: MetricSeries;\n    responseTime: MetricSeries;  // in ms, hourly timeseries\n    errorRate: MetricSeries;     // percentage\n    apdex: MetricSeries;         // 0–1 score\n    cpu: MetricSeries | null;    // null if infra agent unavailable\n    memory: MetricSeries | null;\n  };\n  comparison: MetricComparison[];  // 24h vs 30d for each metric\n  slowQueries: SlowQuery[];        // transactions with databaseDuration > 1s\n  alerts: Alert[];                 // threshold violations + new errors\n}\n```\n\nEach `MetricSeries`:\n```typescript\n{\n  name: string;\n  unit: string;            // 'req/min' | 'ms' | '%' | ''\n  timeseries: Array<{      // one point per hour for last 24h\n    beginTimeSeconds: number;\n    endTimeSeconds: number;\n    value: number;\n  }>;\n  avg24h: number;          // mean of the hourly timeseries\n  monthlyAvg: number;      // 30-day aggregate value\n  changePercent: number | null;  // null if monthlyAvg = 0\n}\n```\n\n## Script Structure\n\n```\nsrc/scripts/newrelic-monitor/\n  types.ts           — TypeScript interfaces for all digest types\n  newrelic-client.ts — NerdGraph batched queries, metric extraction\n  index.ts           — orchestrator: fetch → detect alerts → write digest\n```\n\n## Required GitHub Secrets\n\n| Secret | Description |\n|--------|-------------|\n| `NEW_RELIC_API_KEY` | New Relic User API key (NerdGraph read access) |\n| `NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID` | New Relic account ID (934 for customink) |\n| `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` | Slack incoming webhook for the monitoring channel |\n\n`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is already present in the repo.\n\n## Running Manually\n\n```bash\ngh workflow run newrelic-monitor.yml\n```\n\nTo run the digest script locally:\n\n```bash\nNEW_RELIC_API_KEY=<key> NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID=934 \\\n  npx ts-node --transpile-only src/scripts/newrelic-monitor/index.ts\n```\n\n## Cost\n\n~5–15K tokens/day (Claude Sonnet). ~$1–3/month.\n\n## Relationship to Rollbar Monitor\n\n| | Rollbar Monitor | New Relic Monitor |\n|---|---|---|\n| Schedule | 9:00am UTC | 9:30am UTC |\n| Focus | Error stack traces, auto-fix PRs | Performance metrics, health baselines |\n| Data source | Rollbar (errors) | New Relic NerdGraph (metrics + errors) |\n| Slack report | Error classifications | Metric comparison table + alerts |\n| Auto-fix | Yes (FIXABLE errors) | No |\n\nBoth monitors post to the same `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`. Run them on different channels by using a separate secret if needed.\n"
}
```

**5 files:**

```
src/scripts/newrelic-monitor/
  types.ts          — Digest, MetricSeries, ErrorGroup, Alert, SlowQuery, MetricComparison
  newrelic-client.ts — Single batched NerdGraph request (14 aliases): errors, 
                       throughput/response time/error rate/apdex/CPU/memory timeseries,
                       30-day monthly aggregates, P95 aggregate, slow queries
  index.ts          — Fetch → detect alerts → write newrelic-digest.json

.github/workflows/newrelic-monitor.yml  — Cron at 9:30am UTC, Claude posts Slack report
docs/newrelic-monitor.md                — Full documentation
eslint.config.mjs                       — Added newrelic-monitor to ignore list (matches rollbar pattern)
```

**What it monitors:**
- Errors (last 24h vs prior 24h, new detection)
- Throughput, response time (avg + P95), error rate, Apdex — hourly timeseries + 30-day baseline
- CPU + memory (optional, requires infra agent)
- Slow DB queries (>1s)

**Alerts auto-detected** before Claude even runs: high error rate, slow responses, degraded Apdex, high CPU, traffic drops (>50% vs baseline).

**Required secrets** to add to the repo: `NEW_RELIC_API_KEY`, `NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID` (the `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` already exist).

> DEVELOPER

why is this 2 excluded?
      18        './src/scripts/rollbar-monitor',                                                                                                                                                                                           
      19 +      './src/scripts/newrelic-monitor',

> AGENT

Same reason as rollbar-monitor: these are standalone Node.js scripts, not NestJS modules. They violate two rules that don't apply here:

1. **Relative imports** — `@aliases` are tsconfig path mappings resolved by NestJS's build. `ts-node --transpile-only` doesn't resolve them without `tsconfig-paths` plugin. Runtime would break.

2. **`no-console`** — no NestJS DI context, no `Logger` instance available. `console.log` is the correct tool for GHA step output.

Both exclusions are intentional for the same architectural reason: scripts in `src/scripts/` that run outside NestJS.

> DEVELOPER

will it comapre metrixs from the releases to the last 30 days metrics to see the drift?

> AGENT

No. Current implementation compares **last 24h average** vs **30-day average** — a time window comparison, not release-specific.

If a deploy happened at 2pm, the 24h avg blends pre- and post-deploy metrics together. You can't isolate the release impact.

True release comparison would require:
1. Fetch New Relic deployment markers (NerdGraph entity API)
2. For each deploy in last 24h: fetch metrics 1h pre vs 1h post
3. Compare both windows against the 30-day baseline

That's a separate NerdGraph call — something like:
```graphql
{
  actor {
    entity(guid: "APP_ENTITY_GUID") {
      ... on ApmApplicationEntity {
        deployments(limit: 5) {
          timestamp
          version
          description
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Then per-deploy NRQL with `SINCE X UNTIL Y` windows around each `timestamp`.

Want me to add this? It requires the entity GUID, which we'd fetch dynamically via `entitySearch` using the app name filter.

> AGENT

Yes — Apdex max is 1. Our code is broken: the `apdex()` NRQL function returns an object `{s, t, f, count, score}`, not a plain number. My `extractValue` picks the first entry (`s` = satisfied count = 31,944). That's the bug.

Three fixes needed:
1. Replace `apdex()` NRQL with manual formula that returns a plain number
2. Remove `SystemSample` CPU/memory — it queries the whole account, not scoped to our app

```
1	import type {

9	const NR_GRAPHQL_URL = 'https://api.newrelic.com/graphql';
10	const APP_FILTER = "appName LIKE '%Recommendations Service (production)%'";
11	
12	interface NrRow {
13		[key: string]: unknown;
14	}
15	
16	interface NrResult {
17		results: NrRow[];
18	}
19	
20	interface NerdGraphResponse {
21		data: {
22			actor: {
23				account: {
24					errorsCurrent: NrResult;
25					errorsPrevious: NrResult;
26					throughput: NrResult;
27					throughputMonthly: NrResult;
28					responseTime: NrResult;
29					responseTimeP95agg: NrResult;
30					responseTimeMonthly: NrResult;
31					errorRate: NrResult;
32					errorRateMonthly: NrResult;
33					apdex: NrResult;
34					apdexMonthly: NrResult;
35					cpu: NrResult;
36					memory: NrResult;
37					slowQueries: NrResult;
38				};
39			};
40		};
41	}
42	
43	function extractValue({ value }: { value: unknown }): number {
44		if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
45		if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
46			const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>);
47			const first = entries[0];
48			return first ? Number(first[1]) || 0 : 0;
49		}
50		return 0;
51	}
52	
53	function getField({ row, field }: { row: NrRow; field: string }): number {
54		return extractValue({ value: row[field] });
55	}
56	
57	function buildTimeseries({ rows, field }: { rows: NrRow[]; field: string }): MetricPoint[] {
58		return rows.map((row) => ({
59			beginTimeSeconds: typeof row['beginTimeSeconds'] === 'number' ? row['beginTimeSeconds'] : 0,
60			endTimeSeconds: typeof row['endTimeSeconds'] === 'number' ? row['endTimeSeconds'] : 0,
61			value: getField({ row, field }),
62		}));
63	}
64	
65	function average({ points }: { points: MetricPoint[] }): number {
66		if (points.length === 0) return 0;
67		return points.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.value, 0) / points.length;
68	}
69	
70	function buildSeries({
71		name,
72		unit,
73		rows,
74		field,
75		monthlyValue,
76	}: {
77		name: string;
78		unit: string;
79		rows: NrRow[];
80		field: string;
81		monthlyValue: number;
82	}): MetricSeries {
83		const timeseries = buildTimeseries({ rows, field });
84		const avg24h = average({ points: timeseries });
85		const changePercent =
86			monthlyValue === 0
87				? null
88				: Math.round(((avg24h - monthlyValue) / monthlyValue) * 100);
89		return { name, unit, timeseries, avg24h, monthlyAvg: monthlyValue, changePercent };
90	}
91	
92	function q({ nrql }: { nrql: string }): string {
93		return JSON.stringify(nrql);
94	}

117	        errorsPrevious: nrql(query: ${q({ nrql: `SELECT count(*) as errorCount FROM TransactionError WHERE ${APP_FILTER} FACET error.class, error.message, transactionName LIMIT 30 SINCE 48 HOURS AGO UNTIL 24 HOURS AGO` })}) { results }
118	        throughput: nrql(query: ${q({ nrql: `SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) as throughput FROM Transaction WHERE ${APP_FILTER} SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES 1 hour` })}) { results }
```

```
1	import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
2	
3	import { fetchNewRelicMetrics } from './newrelic-client';
4	import type { Alert, AlertType, Digest } from './types';
5	
6	const THRESHOLDS = {
7		errorRate: { warning: 1, critical: 5 },
8		responseTimeAvgMs: { warning: 1000, critical: 2000 },
9		apdex: { warning: 0.85, critical: 0.7 },
10		cpu: { warning: 70, critical: 85 },
11		throughputDropPercent: -50,
12	} as const;
13	
14	function detectAlerts({
15		errorRate,
16		responseTimeMs,
17		apdex,
18		cpu,
19		throughputCurrent,
20		throughputMonthly,
21	}: {
22		errorRate: number;
23		responseTimeMs: number;
24		apdex: number;
25		cpu: number | null;
26		throughputCurrent: number;
27		throughputMonthly: number;
28	}): Alert[] {
29		const alerts: Alert[] = [];
30	
31		if (errorRate >= THRESHOLDS.errorRate.critical) {
32			alerts.push({
33				type: 'HIGH_ERROR_RATE' as AlertType,
34				metric: 'Error Rate',
35				currentValue: Math.round(errorRate * 100) / 100,
36				threshold: THRESHOLDS.errorRate.critical,
37				severity: 'CRITICAL',
38				description: `Error rate ${errorRate.toFixed(2)}% exceeds critical threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.errorRate.critical}%`,
39			});
40		} else if (errorRate >= THRESHOLDS.errorRate.warning) {
41			alerts.push({
42				type: 'HIGH_ERROR_RATE' as AlertType,
43				metric: 'Error Rate',
44				currentValue: Math.round(errorRate * 100) / 100,
45				threshold: THRESHOLDS.errorRate.warning,
46				severity: 'WARNING',
47				description: `Error rate ${errorRate.toFixed(2)}% exceeds warning threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.errorRate.warning}%`,
48			});
49		}
50	
51		if (responseTimeMs >= THRESHOLDS.responseTimeAvgMs.critical) {
52			alerts.push({
53				type: 'SLOW_RESPONSE' as AlertType,
54				metric: 'Response Time',
55				currentValue: Math.round(responseTimeMs),
56				threshold: THRESHOLDS.responseTimeAvgMs.critical,
57				severity: 'CRITICAL',
58				description: `Avg response time ${Math.round(responseTimeMs)}ms exceeds critical threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.responseTimeAvgMs.critical}ms`,
59			});
60		} else if (responseTimeMs >= THRESHOLDS.responseTimeAvgMs.warning) {
61			alerts.push({
62				type: 'SLOW_RESPONSE' as AlertType,
63				metric: 'Response Time',
64				currentValue: Math.round(responseTimeMs),
65				threshold: THRESHOLDS.responseTimeAvgMs.warning,
66				severity: 'WARNING',
67				description: `Avg response time ${Math.round(responseTimeMs)}ms exceeds warning threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.responseTimeAvgMs.warning}ms`,
68			});
69		}
70	
71		if (apdex > 0 && apdex <= THRESHOLDS.apdex.critical) {
72			alerts.push({
73				type: 'SLOW_RESPONSE' as AlertType,
74				metric: 'Apdex',
75				currentValue: Math.round(apdex * 1000) / 1000,
76				threshold: THRESHOLDS.apdex.critical,
77				severity: 'CRITICAL',
78				description: `Apdex ${apdex.toFixed(3)} below critical threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.apdex.critical}`,
79			});
80		} else if (apdex > 0 && apdex <= THRESHOLDS.apdex.warning) {
81			alerts.push({
82				type: 'SLOW_RESPONSE' as AlertType,
83				metric: 'Apdex',
84				currentValue: Math.round(apdex * 1000) / 1000,
85				threshold: THRESHOLDS.apdex.warning,
86				severity: 'WARNING',
87				description: `Apdex ${apdex.toFixed(3)} below warning threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.apdex.warning}`,
88			});
89		}
90	
91		if (cpu !== null && cpu >= THRESHOLDS.cpu.critical) {
92			alerts.push({
93				type: 'HIGH_CPU' as AlertType,
94				metric: 'CPU',
95				currentValue: Math.round(cpu * 10) / 10,
96				threshold: THRESHOLDS.cpu.critical,
97				severity: 'CRITICAL',
98				description: `CPU ${cpu.toFixed(1)}% exceeds critical threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.cpu.critical}%`,
99			});
100		} else if (cpu !== null && cpu >= THRESHOLDS.cpu.warning) {
101			alerts.push({
102				type: 'HIGH_CPU' as AlertType,
103				metric: 'CPU',
104				currentValue: Math.round(cpu * 10) / 10,
105				threshold: THRESHOLDS.cpu.warning,
106				severity: 'WARNING',
107				description: `CPU ${cpu.toFixed(1)}% exceeds warning threshold of ${THRESHOLDS.cpu.warning}%`,
108			});
109		}
110	
111		if (throughputMonthly > 0 && throughputCurrent > 0) {
112			const dropPct = ((throughputCurrent - throughputMonthly) / throughputMonthly) * 100;
113			if (dropPct <= THRESHOLDS.throughputDropPercent) {
114				alerts.push({
115					type: 'DOWNTIME' as AlertType,
116					metric: 'Throughput',
117					currentValue: Math.round(throughputCurrent * 10) / 10,
118					threshold: throughputMonthly,
119					severity: 'CRITICAL',
120					description: `Throughput dropped ${Math.abs(Math.round(dropPct))}% vs 30-day average — possible downtime or traffic loss`,
121				});
122			}
123		}
124	
125		return alerts;
126	}
127	
128	async function run(): Promise<void> {
129		const apiKey = process.env['NEW_RELIC_API_KEY'];
130		const accountId = process.env['NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID'];
131	
132		if (!apiKey) throw new Error('NEW_RELIC_API_KEY is required');
133		if (!accountId) throw new Error('NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID is required');
134	
135		console.log('Fetching New Relic metrics (last 24h vs 30-day baseline)...');
136	
137		const now = new Date();
138		const since24h = new Date(now.getTime() - 86400 * 1000);
139	
140		const {
141			errorGroups,
142			throughput,
143			responseTime,
144			errorRate,
145			apdex,
146			cpu,
147			memory,
148			slowQueries,
149			comparison,
150		} = await fetchNewRelicMetrics({ apiKey, accountId });
151	
152		console.log(
153			`Fetched: ${errorGroups.length} error groups, ${slowQueries.length} slow queries`,
154		);
155	
156		const newErrors = errorGroups.filter((e) => e.isNew).length;
157		const total24h = errorGroups.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.count, 0);
158	
159		const thresholdAlerts = detectAlerts({
160			errorRate: errorRate.avg24h,
161			responseTimeMs: responseTime.avg24h,
162			apdex: apdex.avg24h,
163			cpu: cpu?.avg24h ?? null,
164			throughputCurrent: throughput.avg24h,
165			throughputMonthly: throughput.monthlyAvg,
166		});
167	
168		const newErrorAlerts: Alert[] = errorGroups
169			.filter((e) => e.isNew && e.count > 10)
170			.map((e) => ({
171				type: 'NEW_ERROR' as AlertType,
172				metric: 'Error',
173				currentValue: e.count,
174				threshold: 0,
175				severity: 'WARNING' as const,
176				description: `New error: ${e.errorClass}${e.errorMessage ? ` — ${e.errorMessage}` : ''} (${e.count} occurrences)`,
177			}));
178	
179		const digest: Digest = {
180			generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
181			period: {
182				from: since24h.toISOString(),
183				to: now.toISOString(),
184			},
185			errors: {
186				total24h,
187				newErrors,
188				groups: errorGroups,
189			},
190			metrics: {
191				throughput,
192				responseTime,
193				errorRate,
194				apdex,
195				cpu,
196				memory,
197			},
198			comparison,
199			slowQueries,
200			alerts: [...thresholdAlerts, ...newErrorAlerts],
201		};
202	
203		writeFileSync('newrelic-digest.json', JSON.stringify(digest, null, 2));
204	
205		console.log(
206			`Digest written to newrelic-digest.json — errors: ${total24h} (${newErrors} new), alerts: ${digest.alerts.length}`,
207		);
208	}
209	
210	run().catch((err: unknown) => {
211		console.error('New Relic monitor failed:', err);
212		process.exit(1);
213	});
214	
```

> AGENT

Pushed to PR #585. Summary of what was wrong and what changed:

**Bug 1 — Apdex > 1**: `apdex()` NRQL returns `{s, t, f, count, score}` object, not a number. My `extractValue` was picking the first entry (`s` = satisfied count = tens of thousands). Fixed by replacing with manual formula:
```sql
(filter(count(*), WHERE duration <= 0.5) + filter(count(*), WHERE duration > 0.5 AND duration <= 2.0) / 2.0) / count(*) as apdex
```
Returns a plain 0–1 number.

**Bug 2 — CPU/Memory account-wide**: `SystemSample` has no `appName` attribute — it queries infra metrics from all hosts in the account, not just our pods. Removed entirely.

> AGENT

NR UI is showing a ~5 month view at 415 rpm. Our 30-day query gives 120 rpm — that's a real discrepancy. The issue is how `rate(count(*), 1 minute)` works in an aggregate query vs TIMESERIES:

- **Aggregate** (`SINCE 30 DAYS AGO`): `total_count / 43,200 minutes` — divides by ALL time including nights/weekends with zero traffic
- **NR UI chart**: averages per-day (or per-hour) data points, **excluding zero/null periods**

Fix: switch monthly queries to `TIMESERIES 1 day` and average the non-zero data points in code. Let me update `newrelic-client.ts`:
